描述_EN: vessels with green lead glaze are typical liao products. liao ceramics are generally plainer than their song counterparts. south china continued to be ruled by the song dynasty emperors. this ewer was made in a northern kiln, at a time when two chinese dynastic rulers co-existed. north china came under the rule of a nomadic people called the qidan, who established the liao dynasty.
描述_ZN: 带有绿色铅釉的容器是典型的辽代产品。 辽代的陶瓷一般比宋代的陶瓷更朴素。 南中国继续由宋朝的皇帝统治。 这个陶器是在北方的窑炉中制造的，当时有两个中国王朝的统治者并存。 中国北方被称为契丹的游牧民族统治，他们建立了辽朝。
